{{*}} [[Amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Edgeville]] |music = [[Barbarianism]] |map = {{Map|name=Barbarian Village|x=3080|y=3427|height=250}} |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} [[File:Barbarian Village standard.png|left|60px]] {{Relativelocation |location = Barbarian Village |north = Edgeville |east = Varrock |south = Draynor Village |west = Falador }} '''Barbarian Village''' is a small village south of [[Edgeville]] and west of [[Varrock]]. The entire village is a [[multicombat area]] containing many [[aggressive]] [[barbarian]]s, so low level players are advised to proceed with caution. Players can enter the [[Stronghold of Security]] through a hole in the centre of the village. ==Transportation== Several transport options bring players into or close to Barbarian Village, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest: * {{plink|Skull sceptre}} — [[Stronghold of Security]] entrance. * {{plink|Canoe|pic=Paddle}} — Barbarian Village station. Requires 12 [[Woodcutting]]. * {{plink|Skills necklace}} — [[Cooking Guild]], just east of the village. * {{plink|Amulet of glory}} — Edgeville centre, just north of the village. * {{plink|Minigame teleport|pic=Minigame icon}} — [[Soul Wars]], which has a [[Soul Wars Portal|portal]] to [[Edgeville]]. * {{plink|Varrock Teleport}} — center of [[Varrock]], well east of the village. ==History== {{LoreSources|Varrock Museum|the1=yes}} Almost 200 years ago, the lost art of [[Runecraft]] was rediscovered, allowing humans to quickly dominate most of [[Gielinor]], and marking the start of the [[Fifth Age]]. The nomadic mountain tribes of [[Rellekka]] embarked on a [[Runecrafting Crusades|crusade]] to stop the use of Magic and Runecrafting, which they believe belong only to the [[gods]]. During this time, the first [[Wizards' Tower]] was burned to the ground (although not by the barbarians), and the magic-using [[Imcando dwarf|Imcando dwarves]] were driven to near-extinction. As casualties mounted, however, the tribes dwindled and were dispersed, and the Barbarian Village was established in between what is now [[Varrock]] and [[Falador]] as a temporary outpost until the tribes could recover their numbers. Over time, the barbarians gradually settled down, and the village became a more permanent establishment. ==Locations== [[File:Barbarian Village.png|thumb|A view of the village.]] === Buildings === {| class="wikitable" !Building !Description |- |[[Long Hall|Longhall]] |The largest building in the village. This is a popular area to train [[ranged]] [[combat]] by using the tables as cover, then moving out to collect [[arrows]] and drops. |- |Lookout tower |A tall building overlooking the path from [[Varrock]]. |- |[[Peksa]]'s [[Helmet Shop]] |The only [[Free-to-play|non-members]] store where players can buy helmets other than [[black full helm]]s. Peksa sells and buys [[Medium helmet|medium]] and [[full helmet]]s of [[Bronze equipment|bronze]], [[Iron equipment|iron]], [[Steel equipment|steel]], [[Mithril equipment|mithril]], and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]]. |- |Spinning hut |A small hut with a [[spinning wheel]]. |- |Storage hut |A small hut with no application. |- |[[Tassie]]'s studio |A studio containing a [[pottery oven]] and a [[potter's wheel]], as well as a [[barbarian anvil]]. |} [[File:Cryptic clue - search chest barbarian village.png|thumb|The spinning hut in Barbarian Village.]] === Skill training spots === Despite its small size, the village has a number of useful training spots and facilities: * The [[barbarian anvil]] can be used to make [[hastae]] after completing [[barbarian training]]. * The [[Barbarian Village mine]] at the centre of the village contains [[coal]] and [[Tin ore|tin]]. * Players can fish with [[feather]]s or [[fishing bait]] at the [[Fishing spots]] east of the village, requiring level 20 and 25 [[Fishing]]. * There is a [[Permanent fire|never-ending fire]] west of the fishing spots, which is popular among [[free-to-play]] players for quickly cooking caught fish. There are also perpetually burning fires in the middle of Peksa's shop and at the end of the [[The Long Hall|longhall]]. * The village is useful for [[Crafting]] training at low levels. Players can use [[soft clay]] with the [[Potter's Wheel|Potter's wheel]] and the [[pottery oven]] nearby to craft pottery items. In the free worlds, this is the only location of a potter's wheel and oven outside of the [[Crafting Guild]]. There is also a [[spinning wheel]] that can be used to make [[balls of wool]] and other spun items. === Spawns === {| class="wikitable" !Item !Spawns !Location !Map |- |{{Plink|Beer}} |3 |Longhall table |{{Map|3077,3443|3077,3439|3080,3441|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=beer}} |- |{{Plink|Bronze pickaxe}} |1 |Spinning hut |{{Map|3081,3429|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Bronze pickaxe}} |- |{{Plink|Cooked meat}} |2 |Longhall table |{{Map|3077,3441|3080,3443|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Cooked meat}} |- |{{Plink|Pot}} |1 |Peksa's shop |{{Map|3074,3431|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Pot}} |} ===Stronghold of Security=== {{Main|Stronghold of Security}} Reached through a hole located in the mining area, the [[Stronghold of Security]], released on [[Update:Security and free-to-play update - the Stronghold of Security|4 July 2006]], is open to both [[members]] and [[free-to-play]] players. The medium-sized dungeon gives rewards for making it to the centre of each of its four levels, each of increasing difficulty. Various [[monsters]] inhabit each level, including [[goblin]]s, [[skeleton]]s, [[ankou]], and several monsters unique to the dungeon, such as [[Minotaur|minotaurs]]. == Quests == * [[Below Ice Mountain]] * [[One Small Favour]] ==Inhabitants== === Personalities === * {{Chatl|Atlas}}, a skilled physical trainer. * {{Chatl|Checkal}}, a self-absorbed bodybuilder. * {{Chatl|Hunding}}, an aloof barbarian who will share the village's history if asked nicely. * {{Chatl|Litara}}, a barbarian waiting for her deceased brother [[Solztun]] to return from the [[Stronghold of Security]]. * {{Chatl|Peksa}}, a helmet merchant. * {{Chatl|Sigurd}}, a [[canoe]] tutor. * {{Chatl|Tassie Slipcast}}, a non-barbarian potter who opened her studio on a loan. === Monsters === * [[Imp]] (x1) * [[Unicorn]] (x2) * [[Barbarian]] (x17) * [[Gunthor the brave]] == Music == {| class="wikitable" !Name !Unlock location ! class="unsortable" |Music track |- |[[Barbarianism]] |Barbarian Village |[[File:Barbarianism.ogg]] |} {{Barbarian Village}} [[Category:Misthalin]]
